translationRepairs: As a boy he struck his maternal grandfather Zhang Dai as remarkable; Dai often told his sons, "This child is the yang force of your house."
As a boy he struck his maternal grandfather Zhang Dai as remarkable; Dai often told his sons, "This child is the Yang Yuan of your house."
陽元 is a personal name used as a comparison, not 'yang force'.
In childhood he was regarded as extraordinary by his maternal grandfather Zhang Dai, who often told his sons, "This boy is your family's yang origin."

Your lordship has studied the Confucian learning and examined antiquity; you are honest, generous, and deeply sincere, and in establishing yourself and practicing the Way you have been consistent from beginning to end. Had you lived in the Master's time, you would surely have ascended Confucius's hall.

Lord Ming studied the Confucian learning and examined antiquity; he is honest, generous, and deeply sincere, and in establishing himself and practicing the Way he has been consistent from beginning to end. Had he lived in the Master's time, he would surely have ascended Confucius's hall.
明公 refers to Ming Shanbin (Lord Ming), not the addressee Xiao Gang; the letter eulogizes the deceased worthies.

He left office to mourn his mother; in observing mourning he exceeded the rites. Crown Prince Zhaoming was concerned and personally wrote an admonition, saying, "Knowing your various virtues, your grief and prostration are excessive, and what you take in is scarcely not overflowing—this greatly pains me.

He left office to mourn his mother; in observing mourning he exceeded the rites. Crown Prince Zhaoming was concerned and personally wrote an admonition, saying, "Knowing your various virtues, your grief and prostration are excessive, and what you take in is scarcely one yi—this greatly pains me.
殆無一溢 means intake is barely one yi (a small food measure), not 'scarcely not overflowing'.

At that time the administrator of Huainan, the Literary and Accomplished Marquis Xiao Ning, fled the rebels into Wu; Xiang sent to welcome Ning as league leader and dispatched An and his elder brother's son Yinggong to lead the host against Zixian.

In a Lu Xiang biography, 兄子 without 其 after 遣黯及 normally means Xiang's elder brother's son, not Lu An's; the English "his" wrongly attaches to An.
